Which diabetic patients have an A1c above 9 with no visit after it? Definition: Diabetes = E10*/E11* on a condition record, an encounter diagnosis or a payer claim. The latest A1c dated 30 to 365 days before as_of is above 9.0%, and there is no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) on days 1-30 after it. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone, virtual and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.

row.question: Which women are overdue for breast cancer screening? Definition: Women aged 52-74 at as_of, alive, with an enrollment span covering as_of, and no mammogram (cancer screening record or CPT 77065-77067, G0202, G0204, G0206) in the 27 months before as_of.
